Lower Text: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have 3 security cards, unsuspend this Digimon.
Upper Text: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with [Shaman] or [Wizard] in its traits, you may trash up to 3 cards from the top of your security stack. For each security card trashed by this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
